profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Rocket
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry, with a focus in Financial Technology. Skilled in Full-Stack Web Development. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Computer Science focused in Computer Software Engineering from Lamar University.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led​ ​weekly​ ​sprint​ ​planning,​ ​working​ ​closely​ ​with​ ​our​ ​publishing​ ​partner​ ​Travian​ ​Games​ ​in​ ​Munich,​ ​Germany. 

Worked​ ​independently​ ​to​ ​carry​ ​out​ ​requirements​ ​requested​ ​by​ ​both​ ​ArtCraft​ ​Entertainment​ ​and​ ​Travian​ ​Games. 

Created​ ​the​ ​current​ ​Crowfall​ ​web​ ​store​ ​using​ ​HTML,​ ​CSS,​ ​and​ ​Angular.js​ ​that​ ​is​ ​implemented​ ​on​ ​top​ ​of​ ​a​ ​third-party​ ​PaaS that​ ​supports​ ​our​ ​account​ ​system,​ ​transactions,​ ​and​ ​various​ ​types​ ​of​ ​store​ ​and​ ​game​ ​functionality. 

Created​ ​a​ ​backend​ ​server​ ​administration​ ​dashboard​ ​using​ ​Node.js,​ ​Angular.js,​ ​MongoDB,​ ​and​ ​AWS​ ​then​ ​migrated​ ​it​ ​onto existing​ ​architecture​ ​that​ ​serves​ ​as​ ​a​ ​production​ ​level​ ​developer​ ​operations​ ​tool.
 
Helped​ ​implement​ ​web​ ​service​ ​API’s​ ​used​ ​to​ ​route​ ​vital​ ​game​ ​data​ ​to​ ​to​ ​our​ ​third-party​ ​PaaS 

Wrote​ ​a​ ​comprehensive​ ​test​ ​suite​ ​using​ ​Jasmine​ ​for​ ​all​ ​web​ ​service​ ​API’s​ ​with​ ​visual​ ​code​ ​coverage​ ​reports​ ​generated​ ​by Istanbul​ ​upon​ ​Teamcity​ ​builds.

Served​ ​as​ ​the​ ​first​ ​line​ ​of​ ​defense​ ​for​ ​any​ ​issues​ ​that​ ​arose​ ​with​ ​any​ ​of​ ​our​ ​web​ ​services,​ ​supporting​ ​a​ ​community​ ​of 200,000.

positions.description:
Primary​ ​contact​ ​for​ ​prospective​ ​investors;​ ​developed​ ​superior​ ​communication​ ​and​ ​customer​ ​facing​ ​skills 

Responsible​ ​for​ ​the​ ​vision,​ ​creation​ ​of​ ​the​ ​business​ ​strategy,​ ​and​ ​execution​ ​of​ ​that​ ​vision 

Design​ ​team​ ​lead​ ​for​ ​a​ ​group​ ​of​ ​four​ ​developers;​ ​effectively​ ​delegating​ ​both​ ​individual​ ​and​ ​team​ ​goals 

Followed​ ​the​ ​vision​ ​through​ ​from​ ​conception​ ​to​ ​implementation​ ​of​ ​a​ ​minimum​ ​viable​ ​product 

Construction​ ​of​ ​the​ ​front-end​ ​content​ ​for​ ​the​ ​application,​ ​website,​ ​business​ ​and​ ​administration​ ​portals

 Demonstrated​ ​ability​ ​to​ ​successfully​ ​manage​ ​software​ ​development​ ​projects​ ​to​ ​satisfy​ ​technical,​ ​budget,​ ​and​ ​schedule requirements 

Used​ ​technologies​ ​such​ ​as​ ​Java,​ ​PHP,​ ​JavaScript,​ ​HTML5,​ ​CSS​ ​and​ ​MySQL​ ​for​ ​implementation​ ​from​ ​the​ ​ground​ ​up.

projects.title: 'Serverless' Stock Market Analysis
projects.description: One of the side projects I have been working on in my spare time is a tool for gaining stock market insights. A general overview for how this works -- I pass in a URL to a REST API that then parses the article into plain text and feeds it to IBM Watson's Natural Language Understanding API. Watson then returns us with a few values behind the article through various forms of emotion. The two I am mainly concerned with is optimism, and disappointment. I can take the delta between these two values to determine how positive or negative someone is speaking about a specific stock. The idea at the macro level is to crawl thousands of websites that I would then feed into this system to gain what could be considered a 'general consensus' about how a stock may perform.
